checklist_items.1.1: On first open the new-network dialog shows four textboxes, three checkboxes, three button radios, and one info alert. There is no spinbutton, no combobox, and no unit. Name is an empty required textbox with maximum length 64 and no placeholder. Description is an empty textbox with maximum length 256, is not required, and has no placeholder. Roles is one required checkbox group. Its three localized role checkboxes are enabled and unchecked. Type is one radio group and is not required. Its three localized type labels are visible button radios, and host_ethernet is checked. With that default the default CIDR and the default interface are visible empty textboxes, are not required, and have no maximum length. The CIDR placeholder is 10.20.0.0/16. The interface placeholder is the localized glob example. Bootstrap CIDR and the advanced section are absent. The info alert message is the localized selector note. The create POST sends the typed name, description E2E control-plane definition, role serving, type host_ethernet, cidr 10.77.0.0/16, and interface ens*. The independent GET stores those same fields.
checklist_items.1.5: Each of the four types is selected by clicking its own button radio, and after every pick that radio is checked while the other three are not - so the group is shown to switch rather than merely render a default. The type dictionary the form offers is the server's list; no request is sent while switching.
checklist_items.1.6: The chosen type decides the rest of the form. host_ethernet and host_rdma show the plain CIDR and interface pair with the selector note, and no advanced disclosure; accelerator_rdma and accelerator_hccs instead hide that pair, keep the bootstrap address inside the advanced disclosure, and show their own inference note. The role checkboxes follow the server's type_roles dictionary: on a host type all three roles are enabled, while on an accelerator type storage sync and serving are disabled and only compute stays enabled. Returning to host_ethernet restores the interface field, and switching never sends a request.
checklist_items.1.2: On first open the new-network dialog shows an empty required name, an empty optional description, the role checkboxes unchecked, and type host_ethernet checked with its CIDR and interface textboxes visible, empty and not required - read from the rendered controls, with no request sent. Reopening Edit refills name, description, CIDR and interface from the stored row before anything is typed.
checklist_items.1.3: The required name is driven with an empty string and with a run of spaces while the roles stay unchecked. Each save shows both the name-required and the roles-required message and sends no request - the two iterations are asserted separately and the mutation list stays empty.
checklist_items.1.7: A minimum create types the four fields and checks the serving role, and the POST carries exactly those values. The 201 opens the detail drawer over the list, the list row for that name is present once, an independent GET returns the same document, and a reload still renders the description and CIDR.
checklist_items.1.8: Creation submits every optional field the dialog offers, including the description and the advanced CIDR and interface together with the serving role, and the independent GET after the 201 returns those same stored values rather than the form's text.
checklist_items.1.12: The rename changes the name and, in the same save, clears the description and interface and sets a new CIDR. The independent GET shows the new name with the emptied and changed fields, and the earlier cancel path proved a cancelled edit stores nothing.
checklist_items.1.14: Every write is followed by a reload and an independent GET, so the rendered drawer is never the only evidence. No node is attached to this contract, so attachment and selector resolution stay MISSING rather than assumed.
checklist_items.1.15: The save sits inside the dialog at 1440x900. Focus starts on the name, Shift+Tab and Tab return to it, its border is the theme primary colour, and fourteen Tab presses in both directions keep document.activeElement inside the dialog. Errors from the required checks are visible text, and Enter while the first POST is held does not submit again.
checklist_items.1.9: While the create POST is held the save button stays loading and a second click sends no further create. The later 201 is the only stored network
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the create dialog and the name, description, CIDR, interface and serving role, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no network. The retry 201 matches the independent detail GET
checklist_items.1.11: covered: Cancel, close and Escape each close the create dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no network write, so the stored networks stay unchanged
checklist_items.10.1: The networks list is driven through its own GET into each of the four states. A held response leaves the list spinning with no data rows. A 503 replaces the table with the loadFailed alert carrying the server's own message, and that frame renders no rows from the list's table; the Retry action inside the alert re-issues the GET, gets 200 and restores the rows. An emptied collection renders the page's own copy rather than the table's generic placeholder, with no rows - the page offers no empty-state action, so none is claimed. A refresh control then brings the real rows back and the empty frame is gone. Every row assertion is scoped to the list's own table because the page renders a second table underneath it.
checklist_items.2.5: Network names are unique per the server, not the form: the store refuses a duplicate with a case-insensitive comparison that excludes the row itself, so 'TAKEN' and 'taken' collide. The case occupies a name through the API, then edits the network under test onto it in upper case, and the save is refused with HTTP 409 and code NETWORK_NAME_TAKEN. The dialog stays open, the name field still shows exactly what was typed, and an independent GET of the record still returns the previous values, so the refused save changed nothing. Renaming in the open dialog to a free name then saves with 200 and the list shows the new name; the collision fixture is deleted afterwards and the collection returns to the baseline it started from. Dropping the uniqueness check in the store makes the collision return 200 and the case fails.
checklist_items.12.1: covered: New network on the networks page opens the dialog named by the create title
checklist_items.12.2: covered: Create dialog at 1440x900: the dialog and footer Save stay inside the viewport, and the title, body and footer sit inside the dialog without overlap
checklist_items.12.3: covered: Default focus is inside the create dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: covered: Cancel, Escape, close and mask each return focus to the New network button and send no network write
checklist_items.12.5: N/A: the network create dialog has no nested child layer
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the create POST is held the footer Save shows the loading state and a second click sends no further create request; the 502 keeps the name, description, CIDR, interface and serving role and shows the server reason; the later 201 matches the independent detail GET and the refreshed fields
checklist_items.12.7: Delete confirmation carries both the name and the consequence: the case replaces {{name}} in the product's own confirmation string, which reads 'Delete network <name>? Running instances keep the network they started with', and requires that exact sentence to be visible inside the viewport before either the cancel or the delete proceeds; a cancel then sends no mutation and an independent GET still returns the stored network. Reference blocking has no object on this resource: no deletion path for a network consults its attachments. writeNetworkErr (internal/server/api/networks.go:245) maps invalid, dedicated-unavailable, attachment-not-found, not-found, name-taken and attachment-exists and nothing in the in-use family, while errors.go defines SERVED_NAME_IN_USE, MODEL_IN_USE, IMAGE_IN_USE and STORAGE_IN_USE on four other resources and never NETWORK_IN_USE; Store.DeleteNetwork (internal/server/store/network_objects.go:98) deletes the row and then its attachments and test runs in the same transaction, so an attached network is removed rather than refused, and that is measured rather than inferred: a node and a network are attached over the API, resolved_node_count reads 1, and DELETE answers 200 {'status': 'deleted'}, not 409. The allowed-cleanup half is that cascade, asserted as the node still existing while the network answers 404 and its name can be reused at once, which is what shows no attachment row survived. The failed-delete half deletes an id that does not exist, requires 404 NETWORK_NOT_FOUND, and then re-reads a second network with its own attachment and requires its attachment count and its name, description, CIDR, interface, roles and type to be unchanged - a 404 alone would show only that an error was reported, not that nothing else moved. The confirmation copy names the consequence for running instances but does not mention that a node's attachment is released; that is recorded as an observation about the copy, not asserted as a defect, because whether the copy should say it is a product decision rather than a testable contract.
checklist_items.12.8: N/A: the network create and edit dialogs have no delete preview, revision, or compare-and-swap
checklist_items.2.2: The create form is submitted with an empty name and then with a whitespace-only name ('   '). Each attempt shows the nameRequired message and the rolesRequired message, the dialog stays open, and the case asserts that both attempts recorded zero mutation events - so a whitespace-only name never reaches the server and no request value or stored value can differ. The form is then filled with the real name before the cancel path, which is separately asserted to send no mutation either.

checklist_items.1.1: On first open the add-storage dialog shows one secondary type-help paragraph, two button radio groups, and seven button radios. There is no spinbutton and no unit. Type is a button radio group labeled with the type label and is not marked required. Its four localized type labels are visible button radios, and local is checked. The type-help paragraph text is the localized local directory sentence. Name is an empty textbox, is not marked required, has no maximum length and no placeholder, and shows the localized 1-to-63 help. Directory is an empty textbox, is not marked required, has no maximum length, and shows the localized directory help. Export, mount options, cache directory, cache limit, shared directory, mount point, steps, the trial-mount button, checkboxes, label rows, and alerts are absent. Scope is a button radio group labeled with the scope title and is not marked required. Its three localized scope labels are visible button radios, and all nodes is checked. The scope help is the localized every-node sentence. One empty combobox offers optional per-node directories. The same run rejects an empty name, a whitespace name, and INVALID_NAME with the name error and sends no storage request, and rejects a relative directory with the absolute-path error and sends no storage request. The create POST body is the trimmed name, type local, the absolute directory, all_nodes true, and targets []. The independent GET stores those fields and enabled true.
checklist_items.1.2: The add-storage dialog opens with an empty name and path and type local checked, and reading it sends no request. Reopening Edit prefills the stored name and path, shows the scope radio checked, and hides the password field for a local row. A 502 on create keeps the same open dialog with both typed values.
checklist_items.1.3: Each required field is driven with an empty string and with a run of spaces. The form marks that field's own item as errored, shows its message, leaves the other field's item clean, keeps the typed text, and sends no POST - four cases across name and path.
checklist_items.1.4: The name rejects a value with an inner space and the path rejects a relative value, each with its own message and no POST. The root boundary is the server's: an absolute path outside storage_probe_roots is sent and refused, with the draft kept open.
checklist_items.1.7: A minimum create fills only the required name and a real absolute path, and the POST carries exactly name, path and type local. The 201 is followed by the detail drawer, an independent GET matching the body, and a reload that still shows the row.
checklist_items.1.8: A full create also selects the label scope, adds label key team with value alpha, and clears all nodes. The POST carries those optionals, the independent GET returns all_nodes false and that one target, and a reload renders team=alpha.
checklist_items.1.12: The rename changes name and path together and the independent GET shows both with type unchanged. The enabled switch then goes false and back to true, each a PATCH of that single field, each confirmed by aria-checked after a reload and by the stored document, with the other fields keeping their values.
checklist_items.1.13: With the edit dialog open, another writer PATCHes the row and advances its revision. Save returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED, the dialog keeps the label draft and shows an alert naming the reason, and the independent GET keeps all nodes, the original path and the other writer's revision. A real second save then succeeds.
checklist_items.1.14: After each write the case reloads and re-reads through an independent GET, so the rendered detail is never the only evidence. No agent or node is attached to this contract, so directory creation and mounts stay MISSING rather than assumed.
checklist_items.1.9: While the create POST is held the footer Save stays disabled and a forced second click sends no further create. The later 201 is the only stored storage
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the add dialog and the typed name and path, shows upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores no storage. The retry 201 matches the independent detail GET
checklist_items.1.11: covered: Cancel, close and Escape each close the add dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no storage write, so the stored storages stay unchanged
checklist_items.10.1: The storage list is driven through its own GET into each of the four states. A held response leaves the table spinning with no rows. A 503 replaces the table with the loadFailed alert carrying the server's own message and no rows at all, and the Retry action in that alert re-issues the GET, gets 200 and restores the rows. An emptied collection renders the storage page's own empty copy - not the table's generic placeholder - together with its Add action and zero rows. Restoring the real collection then shows the populated row and removes the empty frame, so the list is proven to recover to the state it started in.
checklist_items.12.1: covered: Add storage on the storage page opens the dialog named by the add title
checklist_items.12.2: covered: Add dialog at 1440x900: the dialog and footer Save stay inside the viewport, and the title, body and footer sit inside the dialog without overlap
checklist_items.12.3: covered: Default focus is inside the add dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: covered: Cancel, Escape, close and mask each return focus to the Add storage button and send no storage write
checklist_items.12.5: N/A: the local add dialog has no nested child layer
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the create POST is held the footer Save is disabled and a forced second click sends no further create request; the 502 keeps the typed name and path and shows the server reason; the later 201 matches the independent detail GET and the refreshed path
checklist_items.12.7: Delete confirmation names the storage and says model files stay on the nodes while a deployment that uses the storage cannot be removed. A deployment node requirement blocks deletion with 409 STORAGE_IN_USE and the storage and requirement stay. A model file whose state is deleting keeps the storage on 409 and the file stays. After both rows are cleared, delete returns 204, the independent GET is 404, and the reloaded list is empty
checklist_items.12.8: The edit dialog sends the previewed expected_updated_at. After another writer advances the revision, Save returns 409 STORAGE_CONFIG_CHANGED, the label draft stays in the open dialog, and the independent GET keeps all nodes, the original path and the other writer's revision. Teardown is not the assertion
